bullets: On Friday 30 October, Dubai recorded 484 sales worth AED 1.0bn, which is 3.4% above a typical weekday.
Off-plan share was 43.2%, compared to the 7-day average of 59.6%.
The median price was AED 1,351 per square foot, down 19.2% from the 30-day average and down 3.9% from last year.
Over the last seven days, JVC led with 232 sales, followed by Liwan1 with 155 and Dubai South with 136.
In October new rental contracts for JVC 1-bedroom apartments had a median of AED 69,812 a year, up 1.2% on the month.
talking_points: Dubai real estate mortgages reached a record $5.94 billion across 10,000 loans, reflecting buyer purchasing power and financing conditions.
Dubai added 38,000 homes in nine months, which influences local housing supply and market dynamics.
The luxury property market recorded nine sales exceeding $27 million, showing sustained high-net-worth buyer activity.

bullets: On Friday 30 October, Dubai Land Department recorded 484 sales worth AED 1.0bn, which is 3.4% above a typical weekday.
Off-plan sales made up 43.2% of Friday transactions, compared to 59.6% over the last seven days.
The median price was AED 1,351 per square foot, down 19.2% from the 30-day average and 3.9% from last year.
Over the past week, the busiest areas for sales were JVC with 232, Liwan1 with 155, and Dubai South (DWC) with 136.
In October new rental contracts for a 1-bedroom apartment in JVC had a median price of AED 69,812 a year, up 1.2% on the month.
talking_points: Brookfield and Lunate have launched a new Gulf real estate firm, which will influence future regional project pipelines and market supply.
Long-term stays dominated UAE managed properties in Q3, shifting rental duration trends that affect investment strategies.
Dubai ready-property sales increased by eleven percent in Q3, reflecting growing buyer demand and transactional activity in the secondary market.
